description: This file defines the GoogleSSO class for Google Single Sign-On integration, including configuration, initialization, token refresh, and testing setup.

classes.name: GoogleSSO
classes.description: A class extending SSOBase to implement Google OAuth2 SSO functionality, including login, callback handling, token refresh, and configuration testing.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the SSO provider, 'Google SSO'.

methods.name: getCallbackURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the callback URL for Google SSO based on environment variables.

methods.name: setSSOConfig
methods.description: Sets up the SSO configuration, including passport strategy setup with Google OAuth2 details.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the login and callback routes for Google SSO.

methods.name: testSetup
methods.description: Tests the Google SSO configuration by attempting to generate an authorization URL.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes the OAuth token using the stored refresh token.
